component.name: Clickscope
component.summary: Live oscilloscope for Click-board accelerometer telemetry

description.p: Clickscope connects to a MikroElektronika Click board running the clickforge firmware, decodes its COBS/CRC telemetry over USB CDC-ACM, and shows the 3-axis accelerometer stream live: a scrolling X/Y/Z plus magnitude plot, a bubble-level tilt view, numeric readouts, streaming rate and CRC-error statistics, a device console, and CSV recording.
